assumptions.meaning: All are illustrative engineering screen inputs, not measured capabilities, approved force limits or user comfort thresholds

limits: Finite300-design search, not all possible springs or all materials
Reference301 full-hard wire properties are not a manufactured-spring allowable
Coil expansion uses an inextensible uniform-helix approximation
Spring index, lateral instability, end seating, dynamic response and fatigue remain unqualified
Pull/return comparison uses full-engagement static normal reactions; no actual withdrawal/return trajectory is solved
3N is a chosen comparison criterion, not evidence of autistic comfort or dexterity
No spring is selected for manufacture
